title: Pullback of bottom cohomology from local zero-differential models
statement: Let $T$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $D\in D(\mathcal O_T)$ [def-pc-derived-category], and $a\in\mathbb Z$. Suppose every $t\in T$ has an open neighbourhood $U$ and a cochain complex $K$ of $\mathcal O_U$-modules [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules] which is bounded above, zero for $i<a$, has $d^a=0$, and has every term finite free [def-weil-pbc-free-module], with $L(U\hookrightarrow T)^*D\cong Q(K)$ [def-pc-derived-pullback]. For every morphism $g:Y\to T$, there is an isomorphism of module sheaves $g^*H^a(D)\cong H^a(Lg^*D)$ [def-pc-module-pullback]. Derived categories on all schemes are chosen in the same localization universe. No perfection, rank or universal-freeness hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: Apply localZeroBottomModel_truncation to obtain the flat bottom sheaf M=H^a(D) and an arrow f:M[-a] -> D invertible on H^a.

For every y in the source, choose a model chart at g(y). Apply zeroBottomArrow_pullback_local to obtain an open V_y containing y on which H^a(Lg*f) is invertible. These opens cover the source; the sheaf-module open-cover criterion makes this globally specified map invertible.

The private proved flat_single_pullback_iso computes Lg*(M[-a]) from the flat-complex counit, homotopy quotient factorization, localization factorization and single-complex tensor comparison. Compose the inverse single-homology isomorphism, inverse homology of this flat-single comparison, and asIso of H^a(Lg*f), giving g*H^a(D) isomorphic to H^a(Lg*D).

mathlib_searches.query: Bottom cohomology commutes with arbitrary derived pullback for a locally finite free bounded complex with zero outgoing bottom differential
Lowest cohomology of a bounded finite free complex whose first differential is zero commutes with arbitrary pullback
mathlib_searches.results: Eight group-cohomology and HomComplex hits. None asserts scheme-level pullback of bottom cohomology.

Mathlib includes generic short-complex homology and cyclesIsoX for zero differentials; no scheme-level theorem. Source and Sheaf search finds PerfectUniversalH0LocalChainModel (requires a specified truncation arrow in degree zero), BottomChainModelPullbackTransport (transports that arrow), and DerivedOpenPullbackHomology (only open pullbacks). Their hypotheses/conclusions do not supply this statement. Blueprint searches for zero bottom differential and lowest cohomology pullback give no matches.

theorem localZeroBottomModel_pullback
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u}, HasDerivedCategory.{w}
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    (T : Scheme.{u}) (D : schemeDerivedCategory T) (a : ℤ)
    (hmodel :
      ∀ t : T, ∃ U : T.Opens, t ∈ U ∧
      ∃ K : CochainComplex
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace)) ℤ,
        (∃ c : ℤ, ∀ i : ℤ, c < i → IsZero (K.X i)) ∧
        (∀ i : ℤ, i < a → IsZero (K.X i)) ∧ K.d a (a + 1) = 0 ∧
        (∀ i : ℤ, ∃ n : ℕ, Nonempty (K.X i ≅ SheafOfModules.free
          (R := moduleRings U.toScheme.toRingedSpace) (ULift.{u} (Fin n)))) ∧
        Nonempty ((derivedPullback U.ι).obj D ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj K))
    (T' : Scheme.{u}) (g : T' ⟶ T) :
    Nonempty
      ((Modules.tensorPullback g).obj
          ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
            (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T.toRingedSpace)) a).obj D) ≅
        (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings T'.toRingedSpace)) a).obj
            ((derivedPullback g).obj D))
